sub_sector.value: active equity and fixed income investment management

financial_business_type.detail: Global multi-asset active investment manager run through autonomous investment teams.

revenue_driver.detail: Management fees on assets under management, plus performance fees on some strategies.

notes: Customer mix (institutional vs. retail funds) comes from my own knowledge of the firm, not the evidence; the evidence only says "sophisticated clients".
